title: Navy has no original FLIR1 tape, only the leaked copy

tellings.quote: The US military doesn't have the original. The one that they released is the same. It's the one that they got from the German FTP server and then they released it from the US Navy.

plain: The US military does not have the original recording of the FLIR1 video, the 2004 Navy infrared camera footage of the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. So says Mick West, a researcher and UFO skeptic, who gives no source for it. He says the copy the Navy released is the same one that had already turned up on a German FTP server, a file-sharing site on the internet, which would mean the official release was really just the leaked copy.
